title: 第108章 那是神明的眼睛！
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李寒山艰难地抬起头，看着那只还在不断从裂缝中探出的巨脚，眼中只剩下了无尽的震撼。

他无法想象，一只脚就如此巨大，那它的本体，又该是何等的伟岸？

这真的是人类可以抗衡的存在吗？

而就在所有人都被这只巨脚所震撼的时候。

那个宏大而傲慢的声音，再次从九天之上传来。

“蝼蚁，看清楚了。”

“这，便是神明的姿态！”

话音落下，天空中的裂缝猛然扩大！

那尊神明的真身，终于要彻底降临了！

末日降临？

当那只比城市还要巨大的金色巨脚从天幕的裂缝中踏出的那一刻，整个地球的物理规则似乎都开始发生了紊乱。

全球各地的地震监测站，在同一时间发出了最尖锐的警报。

无数条代表着地壳板块活动的曲线，在屏幕上疯狂地跳动，瞬间飙升到了一个前所未有的峰值。

“报告！全球板块出现异常共振！强度……强度无法估算！”

“太平洋海啸预警中心发来急电！全球海平面正在以肉眼可见的速度异常上涨！不是潮汐！是整个星球的水体都在被一股无形的力量牵引！”

“空间观测站报告！地球同步轨道出现偏移！我们……我们正在被一股巨大的引力源拉扯！”

一条条令人心惊胆战的报告，雪片般地汇集到了世界各国的最高指挥中心。

但此刻，没有人能做出任何有效的应对。

因为所有人都明白，这不是自然灾害。

这是“神灾”！

是那个正在从天外降临的恐怖存在，仅仅是其存在的本身，就对这颗星球造成了不堪重负的压力！

“蝼蚁，看清楚了。”

“这，便是神明的姿态！”

那宏大的声音，通过某种未知的介质，清晰地回荡在每一个人类的耳边。

它不再是通过灵魂传递，而是像真正的声音一样，震动着空气，震动着每一个人的耳膜。

无数人在这神音之下，痛苦地捂住了耳朵，七窍流血，瞬间便失去了意识。

只有少数身体素质强大或者意志坚定的人，才能勉强保持清醒。

但清醒，在此刻，或许是一种更大的折磨。

因为他们亲眼看到了，那毕生难忘，足以让任何无神论者都彻底崩溃的一幕。

随着那道声音的落下，天空中的裂缝，猛然扩大到了一个极限！

那片笼罩着半个地球的黑暗天幕，如同舞台的幕布一般，被一只无形的大手，彻底地向两边拉开！

然后，那尊神明的完整法相，终于毫无保留地，展现在了全世界面前！

那是一尊何等伟岸的身影！

他头戴三山飞凤帽，身穿一副锁子黄金甲，脚踏一对藕丝步云履，腰间系一条龙筋狮蛮带。

身躯之庞大，已经无法用任何长度单位来衡量。

地球，这颗直径超过一万两千公里的蓝色星球，在他的面前，就如同一颗小小的弹珠。

他只是静静地站在那里，那双穿着金色战靴的脚，就已经踩入了大气层，激起了万丈波纹。

他的身躯，遮蔽了星空，遮蔽了宇宙。

所有从地球上射向宇宙的电磁波，所有的光，在接触到他身体的瞬间，都被彻底地吸收或扭曲。

人类，在这一刻，与宇宙，彻底“失联”了。

而最让人感到恐惧的，是他的脸。

那张脸，五官俊朗，线条分明，充满了神性的威严。

但最引人注目的，是他额头正中心的位置。

那里，有一道竖着的缝隙。

此刻，这道缝隙，正在缓缓地……

那是一只眼睛！

一只金色的，不带丝毫人类情感，充满了绝对的、冰冷的“理”的……

当这只眼睛睁开的瞬间，一道比之前那道光柱还要璀璨百倍的金色神光，从那只竖眼中爆射而出！

它的目标，不是淮南，不是顾长青。

而是……

那道神光的速度，超越了因果，超越了逻辑。

在地球上的人类眼中，几乎是那只眼睛睁开的同一瞬间，远在三十八万公里之外的月球，就发生了剧变！

“轰——！！！”

一声无法通过真空传播，却又仿佛在每个人心中炸响的轰鸣声过后。

那颗陪伴了地球四十五亿年，引发了无数诗人遐想的皎洁月亮，就像是被一柄无形的重锤正面击中！

它没有爆炸。

而是从被神光击中的地方开始，整颗星球，以一种肉眼可见的速度，迅速地……

巨大的月岩，化作了细小的尘埃。

广袤的环形山，变成了宇宙中的粉末。

在短短几个呼吸之间，整个月球，就彻底地从太阳系中，被抹去了！

只留下了一片由尘埃和碎石组成的，庞大的星环，无声地诉说着它曾经的存在。

仅仅是睁开眼睛时，无意识地扫出的一道神光，就毁灭了一颗星球！

这一刻，全球陷入了死寂。

纽约，时代广场。

所有人都忘记了尖叫，忘记了逃跑。

他们只是呆呆地抬着头，看着天空中那个被神明身影所取代的，曾经属于月亮的位置，大脑一片空白。

伦敦，泰晤士河畔。

一个正在直播的网红，手机掉在了地上都毫无察觉。

他张着嘴，脸上写满了人类最原始的恐惧。

东京，涩谷街头。

无数的屏幕上，都同步播放着这末日般的一幕。

一个穿着校服的女孩，双腿一软，跪倒在地，失声痛哭。

全世界，数十亿人，在这一刻，都感受到了同一种情绪。

那就是，绝望。

彻彻底底，看不到一丝希望的……

7a49局指挥中心。

所有的屏幕，在月球被摧毁的瞬间，全部变成了刺眼的雪花。

不是设备坏了，而是所有的太空探测器，连同月球一起，都化为了宇宙的尘埃。

“完了……”

周玄策无力地瘫坐在椅子上，他感觉自己的脊椎骨，仿佛被抽掉了一般。

他想到了无数种可能，想到了战争，想到了核弹，想到了生化危机。

他为这个国家，为这个民族，准备了无数个预案。

但他从来没有想过，有一天，他们要面对的敌人，会是……

一个，弹指间，就能毁灭星球的神。

这，还怎么打？

人类，拿什么去打？

而此刻，跪在淮南禁区边缘的林薇，也同样看到了这让她肝胆俱裂的一幕。

她不懂什么法天象地，也不懂什么神威。

她只看到了，天上的那个“人”，睁了一下眼睛，然后，月亮……

就没了。

一种比死亡还要恐怖的寒意，瞬间席卷了她的全身。

她的身体，开始不受控制地剧烈颤抖起来。

林薇在发抖。

不是因为冷，也不是因为害怕死亡。

而是一种更加深邃，更加彻底的恐惧，攫住了她的心脏，让她浑身上下的每一个细胞都在尖叫。

月亮……

Li Hanshan raised his head with difficulty and looked at the giant foot that was still protruding from the crack. There was only endless shock in his eyes.

He couldn't imagine that one foot was so huge, so how majestic its body must be?

Is this really something humans can contend with?

And just when everyone was shocked by this giant foot.

That grand and arrogant voice came from the sky again.

"Ant, see clearly."

"This is the posture of a god!"

As soon as the words fell, the cracks in the sky suddenly expanded!

The true form of that god is finally coming!

The end is coming?

The moment the giant golden foot, which was bigger than the city, stepped out from the crack in the sky, the physical rules of the entire earth seemed to be disrupted.

Earthquake monitoring stations around the world issued the sharpest warnings at the same time.

Countless curves representing the activity of tectonic plates were beating crazily on the screen, instantly soaring to an unprecedented peak.

"Report! There is an abnormal resonance of global plates! The intensity...the intensity cannot be estimated!"

"The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center sent an urgent call! The global sea level is rising abnormally at a speed visible to the naked eye! It's not the tide! It's the water bodies of the entire planet that are being pulled by an invisible force!"

"Space Observatory Report! The geosynchronous orbit has deviated! We...we are being pulled by a huge gravitational source!"

A series of frightening reports came to the highest command centers around the world like a snowflake.

But at this moment, no one can make any effective response.

Because everyone understands that this is not a natural disaster.

This is a "divine disaster"!

It is that terrifying existence that is descending from the sky. Its mere existence has put overwhelming pressure on this planet!

"Ant, see clearly."

"This is the posture of a god!"

That majestic sound, through some unknown medium, clearly echoes in every human ear.

It is no longer transmitted through the soul, but like a real sound, vibrating the air and vibrating everyone's eardrums.

Under this divine voice, countless people covered their ears in pain, their orifices bled, and they lost consciousness in an instant.

Only a few people with strong physical fitness or strong will can barely stay awake.

But being awake, at this moment, may be a greater torture.

Because they saw it with their own eyes, a scene that would be unforgettable for a lifetime and enough to make any atheist completely collapse.

As the sound fell, the cracks in the sky suddenly expanded to a limit!

The dark sky covering half of the earth was like a stage curtain, being completely pulled open to both sides by a big invisible hand!

Then, the complete form of the god was finally revealed to the whole world without any reservation!

What a majestic figure that is!

He wears a three-mountain flying phoenix hat on his head, a pair of chain-locked golden armor, a pair of lotus-root silk walking shoes, and a dragon-muscled lion belt around his waist.

The body is so huge that it cannot be measured by any unit of length.

The Earth, a blue planet with a diameter of more than 12,000 kilometers, was like a small marble in front of him.

He just stood there quietly, and his feet wearing golden combat boots had already stepped into the atmosphere, causing thousands of ripples.

His body covered the starry sky and the universe.

All electromagnetic waves and light emitted from the earth to the universe were completely absorbed or distorted the moment they came into contact with his body.

At this moment, human beings have completely "lost contact" with the universe.

The most frightening thing is his face.

That face, with handsome features and clear lines, was full of divine majesty.

But the most eye-catching thing is the center of his forehead.

There, there is a vertical gap.

At this moment, this gap is slowly...

That's an eye!

A golden one, devoid of any human emotion, full of absolute, cold "reason"...

When this eye opened, a golden divine light that was a hundred times more brilliant than the previous beam of light burst out from the vertical eye!

Its target is not Huainan or Gu Changqing.

But...

The speed of that divine light transcends cause and effect and logic.

In the eyes of humans on earth, almost at the same moment when that eye was opened, the moon, which was 380,000 kilometers away, underwent drastic changes!

"Boom——!!!"

After a roar that could not travel through the vacuum, but seemed to explode in everyone's heart.

The bright moon, which has accompanied the earth for 4.5 billion years and triggered the imagination of countless poets, was like being hit head-on by an invisible heavy hammer!

It didn't explode.

But starting from the place where it was hit by the divine light, the entire planet quickly moved at a speed visible to the naked eye...

The huge moon rock turned into fine dust.

The vast crater turned into powder in the universe.

In just a few breaths, the entire moon was completely wiped out from the solar system!

Only a huge star ring composed of dust and rubble was left, silently telling its past existence.

Just when he opened his eyes, a divine light swept out unconsciously and destroyed a planet!

At this moment, the world fell into deathly silence.

New York, Times Square.

Everyone forgot about screaming and running away.

They just raised their heads blankly, looking at the place in the sky that once belonged to the moon, replaced by the figure of the god, and their minds went blank.

London, by the Thames.

An Internet celebrity who was live broadcasting dropped his phone on the ground without even realizing it.

His mouth was open, and his face was filled with the most primitive fears of mankind.

Tokyo, Shibuya streets.

This apocalyptic scene was played simultaneously on countless screens.

A girl in school uniform fell to her knees and cried bitterly.

Billions of people around the world are feeling the same emotion at this moment.

That is, despair.

Completely, without a glimmer of hope...

Bureau 7a49 command center.

All the screens turned into dazzling snowflakes the moment the moon was destroyed.

It's not that the equipment is broken, but that all space probes, along with the moon, have turned into dust in the universe.

"It's over..."

Zhou Xuance slumped weakly on the chair. He felt as if his spine had been pulled out.

He thought of countless possibilities, thought of war, thought of nuclear bombs, thought of biological crisis.

He has prepared countless plans for this country and this nation.

But he never thought that one day, the enemy they would face would be...

A god who can destroy planets with a snap of his fingers.

How to fight this?

Human beings, what are you going to fight with?

At this moment, Lin Wei, who was kneeling on the edge of the Huainan restricted area, also saw this scene that made her heartbroken.

She doesn't understand the laws of heaven, earth, and heaven, nor does she understand divine power.

She only saw the "person" in the sky, opened his eyes, and then, the moon...

It’s gone.

A chill that was more terrifying than death swept through her body instantly.

Her body began to tremble violently uncontrollably.

Lin Wei was trembling.

Not because of the cold, nor because of fear of death.

It was a deeper, more thorough fear that seized her heart and made every cell in her body scream.
